intro: Football is the most popular sport in Timor-Leste, and the country has competed at the Olympics since 2000.

chapters.title: Football
text: The national team joined FIFA in 2005. The Tour de Timor mountain-bike race crossed the country's rugged roads.

chapters.title: Olympics
text: Timorese athletes first marched under the Olympic flag in 2000, before independence.
